title: Rav Akavya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the [end of Avodah Zarah](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.76b.1), Rava says, “Who could be clever enough to do such a thing but Rav Akavya, a man of ability?” The Arukh and [Tosafot, Shabbat 42b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Shabbat.42b.1.1), read Rav Ukva or Mar Ukva. See also [Tosafot on Nazir 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Nazir.53a.1.1).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The question about preparing the large pot starts at [Avodah Zarah 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.76a.18). In the continuation, Rava asks who could have devised the solution except Rav Akavya, “a great man.” Tosafot on Shabbat names Mar Ukva in this same episode.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2915&lang=en) distinguishes the Arukh’s Rav Ukva from Tosafot’s Mar Ukva. Tosafot on Nazir offers a textual reconstruction involving Mar Ukva alongside a different explanation that retains the received text.
